user.title: Tapo camera
user.description: Use the same TP-Link cloud account (e-mail / password) that the Tapo app and Home Assistant's TP-Link integration use.

data.discovery: Follow the camera to a new IP address (MAC discovery)

data_description.scan_interval: The TP-Link integration polls every 5 seconds.
data_description.session_renew: The cameras end the session about 10 minutes after login, and the next request fails once. The integration logs in again before that. 0 turns it off.
data_description.discovery: Looks for the camera by MAC address at start and every 15 minutes, like the TP-Link integration. Turn off if the camera has a static IP.
